chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five Liberations of Wisdom from Falsity

---

**¶1:** [GAP-1] five [GAP-2] by which divine wisdom is rescued from all [GAP-3] false persuasions and evil influences of hell.

---

**¶2:** The first loosening and liberation is that of [GAP-4] the primordial celestial will, for when the celestial will was freed from the captivity of hellish falsities by Divine Truth proceeding from the Lord, who had come [GAP-5] to the celestial will, much wisdom and [GAP-6] much divine power was rescued from the entire dominion of evil. These goods ascended with the restored celestial will into the heavenly states [GAP-7] of the celestial kingdom. This [GAP-8] is the first liberation.

---

**¶3:** The second liberation is that accomplished through Divine spiritual truth proceeding from the Lord, for when Divine Love and [GAP-9] Divine Wisdom together formed [GAP-10] the planes of consciousness and ordered states of the mind [GAP-11] — the natural faculties and their governing affections — immeasurable wisdom was rescued from them [GAP-12] — that which the primordial celestial will had possessed and which was consumed [GAP-13] when wisdom [GAP-14] was devoured by evil.

---

**¶4:** [GAP-15] three states of spiritual combat [GAP-16] up to the time when the Divine [GAP-17] was exalted [GAP-18] above [GAP-19] the entire created order of the mind.

---

**¶5:** The third liberation is that of the Divine [GAP-20] manifestation proceeding into the rational plane, which revealed [GAP-21] the Divine Human form before the dominion of evil; this manifestation [GAP-22] acted upon the ruling falsity and [GAP-23] drew forth wisdom from the powers of hell [GAP-24]. So this is [GAP-25] how the [GAP-26] Divine Human form that [GAP-27] was made manifest in this third proceeding of Divine Truth into the rational mind.

---

**¶6:** The fourth liberation is that of Divine Truth in the fullness of its glory, for when it was revealed in the intermediate spiritual region it displayed the Divine Human form before the ordered divisions of heaven and purified [GAP-28] the wisdom that dwells in the higher states. It took on the likeness [GAP-29] of successive spiritual appearances; it made itself present among the angelic societies in [GAP-30] their various degrees, until it journeyed and descended into the plane of natural and sensory life. It set in order the natural states of the mind and all the bonds that hold the faculties together. It also loosen[GAP-31]ed wisdom beyond measure throughout the entire structure of consciousness. It gave [GAP-32] the calling of Divine truth and the capacity for reception to every faculty, and thereby formed the new regenerated understanding. This Divine Truth then ascended and came to rest in the celestial [GAP-33] kingdom.

---

**¶7:** The fifth liberation is that of Divine Providence operating as a whole, which is the calling of truth and the willing reception of good, for it also [GAP-34] draws the interiors of the person from the [GAP-35] celestial kingdom into active life.

---

**¶8:** [GAP-36] Divine spiritual truth [GAP-37] bestowed [GAP-38] the liberation [GAP-39] through successive degrees. The first [GAP-40] stage ascended and [GAP-41] opened the interiors, proceeding through [GAP-42] the light of understanding [GAP-43] into higher perception. The fourth [GAP-44] stage communicated its understanding [GAP-45] to lower planes. And also the fifth [GAP-46] flows into the whole person and sets it in order, [GAP-47] imprinting the form of divine wisdom into this final collective spiritual image — the completed human form.

---

**¶9:** These five great divine operations [GAP-48] were revealed. They came to fruitful effect [GAP-49] and were established upon [GAP-50] the primordial celestial will [GAP-51] when it proceeded toward [GAP-52] liberation from the combat with evil. The Divine set in order and constructed [GAP-53] the entire created order of the mind [GAP-54], and the primordial celestial [GAP-55] will was restored through this Divine advent.

---

**¶10:** In this way [GAP-56] these liberating operations stand conjoined with [GAP-57] one another in a single Divine order.

---

**¶11:** [GAP-58] Because of the wisdom that had poured forth from [GAP-59] the Divine manifestation in the rational plane.

---

**¶12:** Divine Providence, which is the calling of truth and the willing reception of good, will accomplish [GAP-60] the final confirmation and seal of the Divine commandment and the [GAP-61] mission of all [GAP-62] those who transmit Divine truth. In this last state of the church they [GAP-63] bring to completion the life of the collective spiritual form, and the Divine judges the interior states of every soul, [GAP-64] so that the Divine can send forth [GAP-65] the operations of good, and they [GAP-66] are separated from the [GAP-67] dominion of evil, and what [GAP-68] is alive in the person is preserved [GAP-69] according to the will of the [GAP-70] Divine, who is the established and [GAP-71] all-powerful source; the regenerated go forth against the [GAP-72] enemy, and they [GAP-73] overcome every falsity, and they conquer the natural plane which they have [GAP-74] inhabited and sanctified for ever. [GAP-75] They came forth from the Divine in the beginning, as they will return again to wisdom. They ascend to the Divine at the last.

They ascended with the First Man to the aeons [of] greatn[ess]. This [is the first] release.

The second saving is that of the Liv[ing] Spirit, since whe[n] the Father of Life and [the] Mother of [Li]fe constructed [the ten firmaments] and [w]orlds [of wo]rlds, the earths and their [rulers; im]measurable light was saved f[r]om them [that of the First] Man, who w[a]s devoured [and the] lig[ht was consumed by them]
[ ... ... ] three wars [... ...] to the time when he [... ...] above [all of] them upon the [... ...] universe.

The counse[l] of life, which is the [s]ummons and the obedience, will make [... ...] seal the commandment and the [mission] of all [the] apostles. In this last season they [complete the] life of the S[t]at[ue and] he judges the sou[ls, so that he] can send [... ...] powers, they [are separated] from the [powers of Darkness, and] it is alive [by the power] of the will [of the great] Father, the establ[ished one and all] powerful; they g[o forth against the] enemy, they [overcome] all of them [and they] conquer this land that they have [dwelt and purified] in it for ever [... ... t]hey came fr[om h]im in the beginning, as t[hey will r]eturn again to the light. They [as]cend to him at the la[st].

fills.explanation: Standard Kephalaia chapter-opening formula for enumerating categories; confirmed by the spiritual reading's enumerative structure.
The chapter repeatedly uses "release" and "saving" as its key terms; "releases by which the light is saved" matches the chapter's enumeration formula.
"The rulers and powers of Darkness" is the standard Kephalaia pair for the forces of evil; the spiritual reading confirms "false persuasions and evil influences."
Standard definite article before "First Man," confirmed by every other occurrence of the title in this chapter.

In Manichaean cosmogony, the Living Spirit descended to rescue the First Man; "come to the aid of" naturally governs the following "of the First Man" and matches the spiritual reading's "came to the celestial will."
Parallel construction "much light and much power" is confirmed by the spiritual reading's "much divine power."
"Aeons of greatness" is the standard Kephalaia designation for the divine realm, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "heavenly states of the celestial kingdom."
Summary formula closing the first saving; "This is the first release" matches the pattern and the spiritual reading's "This is the first liberation."
Standard article before "Mother of Life" in the canonical pair "the Father of Life and the Mother of Life."

In Manichaean cosmogony the Living Spirit constructed the ten firmaments (heavens); the spiritual reading confirms "the planes of consciousness" and the text continues with "and worlds" listing cosmic structures.
Completes the Semitic-style intensifier "worlds of worlds" (kosmos n-kosmos), a comprehensive designation for the cosmic realms constructed by the Living Spirit.
The light saved from the rulers was specifically the light belonging to the First Man; the spiritual reading confirms "that which the primordial celestial will had possessed."
Connects the clause about the First Man being devoured to the clause about the light; the spiritual reading indicates both the will and its wisdom were consumed.
Completes "light" and describes its fate; the spiritual reading confirms "wisdom was devoured by evil" — the light-armor of the First Man was consumed by the rulers of Darkness.
The divine was exalted above ALL the cosmic powers; "above all of them" is the natural intensifier, and the spiritual reading confirms comprehensive dominion over the entire created order.
Completes "Third Ambassador" and introduces the temporal clause using the exact same "since when" formula found in ¶2 and ¶3, establishing the parallel structure of all five savings.
The Third Ambassador displayed his male-female image to the archons to cause the release of light; the spiritual reading confirms "revealed the Divine Human form before the dominion of evil."
Confirmed by the spiritual reading's "So this is how"; standard Kephalaia summary formula.

The summary identifies the third saving as operating through the Ambassador's image; "saving" matches the chapter's central vocabulary and the spiritual reading's focus on the Divine Human form as instrument of liberation.
The image was manifested/revealed in the Third Ambassador; the spiritual reading confirms "was made manifest in this third proceeding of Divine Truth."
"The light that is above" corresponds to the spiritual reading's "the wisdom that dwells in the higher states"; "light" is the standard Kephalaia term for divine wisdom.
Jesus the Splendour took on the likeness of the powers/firmaments as he descended; "of them" refers to the beings of each level, matching the spiritual reading's "successive spiritual appearances."
Jesus appeared like the angels in the heavens before descending to flesh; the spiritual reading confirms "among the angelic societies in their various degrees."
Completes "loosened" and pairs it with "saved," matching the chapter's consistent pairing of "loosening and saving" as the dual action of liberation.
Standard definite article before the established phrase "the summons and the obedience," confirmed by the identical phrase in ¶7.
"The light land" (land of light) is the standard Manichaean term for the divine realm; the spiritual reading confirms "the celestial kingdom."

The fifth saving's mechanism is the summons and obedience (Call and Answer); "saves the soul from the land of greatness" means it saves the soul that originates from the light realm, matching the chapter's central vocabulary.
"Land of greatness" is a standard Kephalaia designation for the divine realm, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "celestial kingdom."

The fourth stage (Jesus the Splendour) communicates its wisdom downward to the natural plane; the spiritual reading confirms "to lower planes" and the Kephalaia naturally designates the lower realms as "those below."

The fifth operation sets things in order AND forms/imprints the light image into the Last Statue; the spiritual reading confirms "imprinting the form of divine wisdom into this final collective spiritual image."
Completes "powers" and specifies them as "powers of saving," matching the chapter's subject — the five great saving operations; the spiritual reading confirms "five great divine operations."

Echoes ¶2's own language ("the First Man was freed from the prison of the rulers"); the spiritual reading's summary confirms the First Man proceeded toward liberation, and "was freed" is the chapter's established verb for this event.

The First Man came toward the light realm from the struggle with Darkness; "the light" is the standard Kephalaia term for the divine goal of ascent, matching the spiritual reading's "toward liberation."
Parallels "the entire structure" in ¶6; the spiritual reading confirms "the entire created order of the mind."
Completes "Man" and states the First Man's restoration; the spiritual reading confirms "the primordial celestial will was restored through this Divine advent."
The five liberating operations stand conjoined with one another; the spiritual reading confirms "conjoined with one another in a single Divine order."
Pairs with "apostles" (those who are sent); the spiritual reading confirms "the mission of all those who transmit Divine truth."
Standard definite article before "apostles," confirmed by the spiritual reading.
The apostles bring to completion the life of the Statue in the last season; the spiritual reading confirms "bring to completion the life of the collective spiritual form."
Completes "souls" and introduces the purpose clause; the spiritual reading confirms "judges the interior states of every soul, so that the Divine can send forth."
The saved souls are separated from the dominion of evil; the spiritual reading confirms "they are separated from."
"Powers of Darkness" is the standard Kephalaia term for the dominion of evil; the spiritual reading confirms "dominion of evil, and what is alive" requiring a connector to the next clause.
What is alive in the person is sustained by the power of the Father's will; the spiritual reading confirms "is alive in the person is preserved according to the will."
"The great Father" reflects the Manichaean title "Father of Greatness"; the spiritual reading confirms "the will of the Divine" with the established epithet of supreme authority.
Completes "established one" and connects it to "all-powerful"; the spiritual reading confirms "the established and all-powerful source" — two divine attributes.
Completes "go" and describes the advance against evil; the spiritual reading confirms "the regenerated go forth against the enemy."
The saved souls overcome the forces of evil; the spiritual reading confirms "they overcome every falsity."
Connects the two clauses of conquest; the spiritual reading confirms "overcome every falsity, and they conquer."
The saved souls have both inhabited and sanctified the natural plane; the spiritual reading confirms "inhabited and sanctified for ever" — purified is the Kephalaia equivalent of sanctified.
